mobile.rationale: Transitive Expo SDK 54 tooling dependencies; upgrade requires coordinated Expo SDK migration. image-size currently has no patched release for the DoS advisories; uuid v7 is pinned by Expo tooling.
mobile.compensatingControl: These packages are build-time transitive dependencies; no server-side user input is passed to their vulnerable parsers. Dependabot remains enabled and the exception expires before the next release train.

admin.rationale: React Router 7.18.2 is pinned; the current audit database offers only an incompatible downgrade as a fix.
admin.compensatingControl: The dashboard uses client-side routing only and does not use React Server Components or server actions; re-evaluate on every weekly scan.
